newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Finnair 6-mth profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Finnair 6-mth profit seen down.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 292 million markka median forecast for national carrier Finnair Oy's April-September profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on November 29 around 1300/1100 GMT. @
In April-September 1995, Finnair posted a 463 million markka profit.
For Finnairs' full-year 1996 profit, eight of the 11 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 419 million markka (mean 409 million) in a 280-525 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities and Opstock.
